My husband spent YEARS trying to get me to play golf with him. In 2020, I finally caved… and it turned out to be exactly what I needed in that season of life. We spent our first anniversary playing the beautiful courses on Kiawah Island, and after that golf and travel became our perfect combo. ⛳️

Fast forward to 2025: two young toddlers, a whole lot of motherhood, and a need for community—and mahjong found me. That same feeling of making time for myself, learning something new, and finding my people. 🀄️

Turns out, golf and mahjong have plenty in common: a little strategy, a little luck, a “just one more” mentality, and good company making even the questionable shots and discarded tiles worth it. 😉
